§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 media vocabulary to advanced C1 production and distribution discourse, every module is anchored in real-world media scenarios — from broadcast journalism to streaming platforms, from social media strategy to virtual production. Built for use inside broadcast networks, streaming services, production studios, and digital media agencies.

01

GenAI content creation, smart distribution, and predictive audience analytics run throughout the program — reflecting today's media industry.

Brice Gadou

Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. Mediatic reflects his vision: language learning as storytelling power — a multiplier of careers, platforms, and reach.

Designed for the producers, editors, and content leaders shaping global media — Mediatic is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to broadcast in one of the most influential industries of our time.
